name: Research a Buffalo property
description: A human-executable source packet for parcel, vacancy-signal, permit, violation, rental-registration, and context research in Buffalo and Erie County.

sourceMetadata.reviewMethod: Manual check of each official landing page and source purpose.
sourceMetadata.reviewScope: URL reachability and publisher identity, not an audit of every record.
sourceMetadata.sourcePolicy: Prefer first-party City, County, State, and federal pages. Keep the source's own caveats with every observation.

updateMetadata.beforeUse: Recheck any source used for a current status, deadline, ownership, compliance, or environmental conclusion.
updateMetadata.procedure: Update sources.json and this manifest's reviewedAt, then test the workflow on one address.

limits: No automation, monitoring, scraping, or integration is included.
A public record is not a complete statement of current physical conditions.
The pack does not determine vacancy, ownership, title, code compliance, eligibility, or legal rights.
The pack is not legal, tax, housing, engineering, or environmental advice.
